logs.description: Every run with its step-by-step log, plus a record of what admins changed. Secrets are redacted before anything is stored.
platforms.intro: An instance is a Gitea / Forgejo address. Each access under it is one credential with its own scope and rules — what that token can see is what it backs up.
platforms.discovery_failing: failing {count} times in a row, see Logs → Activity
platforms.mirrors_skipped: Pull mirrors on the platform are always skipped.
platforms.pattern_hint: One owner/name pattern per line; * matches anything. Applied on every discovery.
platforms.sync_interval: Default sync interval for new tasks (minutes)
platforms.sync_interval_hint: Minimum {minimum} minutes. Used for newly discovered tasks.
platforms.schedule_hint: Discovery and syncs share a worker pool. The same task or access never runs concurrently. Repeated failures back off up to 6 hours and recover after a success.
platforms.preview_empty: Run a preview to see what would change.
platforms.preview_note: Excluded tasks are disabled, not deleted — their archive and preserved history stay. Repositories already managed by another access are left to that access.
platforms.last_summary: Last discovery: {created} added, {existing} kept, {disabled} disabled, {skipped} skipped.
platforms.select_access_hint: Choose an access on the left to edit its scope and rules, or add an access to an instance.

platforms.reason.unknown: Filtered by the current scope or rules: {pattern}
creds.intro: Secrets are never shown again after saving. To rotate one, create a new credential and switch references to it.
creds.name: Name
creds.delete_in_use_title: Remove references before deleting this credential.
creds.empty: No credentials yet. Public sources can be backed up anonymously.
creds.private_key_hint: Paste the private key. It is used only for Git operations.
creds.known_hosts_hint: Pin the server host key. Host key verification remains enabled.
creds.username_hint: For platform access, use the account that owns the token.
creds.secret_hint: Stored locally and never included in logs or shown again.

tasks.subtitle: Each task backs up one source repository. Platform accesses create and manage tasks automatically; you can also add any Git repository by hand.
tasks.filters.label: Task filters
tasks.table.label: Task list
tasks.bulk.hint: Select tasks, then choose an action:
task.retry_hint: Check the target repositories and retry this target.
task.events_hint: Only force pushes, rewritten tags and deletions appear here — regular commits don't. Each one can be restored on its own.
task.bundle_hint: Self-contained with full history — works without GitWarden.
task.restore_from_history: Or get it straight from the target's history repository:
task.interval_duration: The interval is {minutes} min because recent runs take longer.
task.interval_backoff: The interval is {minutes} min while failures back off.
wizard.subtitle: Back up any single Git repository by URL — no platform needed. To back up many repositories from Gitea / Forgejo,
wizard.name_hint: Display only — you can change it later.
wizard.source_hint: https://, ssh:// and git@host:path are supported. Don't put passwords in the URL — use a credential.
wizard.interval_hint: Minimum {minimum}. The next run is counted from when the previous one finishes, so runs never pile up.
wizard.targets_intro: Each target is two repositories: the mirror tracks upstream; the history repo keeps only versions overwritten by force pushes or deletions.
wizard.mode_platform_hint: Gitea / Forgejo: creates private repos, disables Actions, protects gw/* tags and binds them.
wizard.mode_manual_hint: Works with any Git server. Both repos must already exist and be empty.
wizard.platform_target_hint: Creates private repositories, disables Actions, protects gw/* tags and binds them.
wizard.platform_name_hint: Creates the repository and its history companion.
wizard.prerequisites_title: Prerequisites (Git can't enforce these — please confirm)
wizard.prerequisite_writer: Only GitWarden's account can write the history repo, and nothing else syncs or writes to the targets
wizard.prerequisite_no_ci: Pushes won't trigger CI, webhooks or deployments (including org- and system-level webhooks)
wizard.review_hint: The target is bound and a first run starts right away. If either repo isn't empty, binding fails — GitWarden never takes over or overwrites existing repos.
wizard.prerequisites_required: Confirm all three prerequisites to create the task.
task.incomplete_backup_hint: LFS files and submodule contents are outside GitWarden's backup scope.
run.gate_blocked: Blocked: the history repo lacks old versions: {items}

task.edit_target_hint: Changing a repository URL unbinds the target; bind the new empty repositories before the next push. Credential changes keep the existing binding.
task.delete_target_hint: This removes the target from GitWarden only. The remote repositories and the local archive stay untouched.
